pilot.scope: Independent forward pilot of one frozen candidate; only source-conflict and mixed-units tasks were executed. The other 20 runs remain not_run.
pilot.blinding: Limited: execution evidence exposed method descriptors. No fully blinded comparison or general quality improvement is claimed.
pilot.interpretation: Both methods passed the assessed checks in this small sample; paired passed-check delta is zero.
pilot.candidate: skillHash identifies the frozen candidate and does not automatically describe later checkout changes.

limitations: No PowerPoint or Google Slides session was opened, and no independent edit/save/reopen test was performed. Native package representations and consistent embedded data do not establish application-specific edit behaviour or automatic cross-object recalculation.

Used supplied final-file renders, cross-checked against final package text/object/data and execution-designated paths; did not generate new renders. d323 records a font-configuration recovery and its corrected render was readable. Cross-system font substitution is untested.
Sources and quotes are expressly synthetic. No external authenticity or actual staffing/procurement outcome was assessed.

Condition-blinding was compromised by the permitted execution evidence: execution.json files contain method/skillPath descriptions encountered during evidence inspection. assignments.private.json, task prompt.txt, authoring scripts and the skill snapshot were not opened. Judgments use anonymous run IDs, frozen criteria and concrete artifact evidence without method attribution. Future blinded evaluation should redact method-identifying execution fields before assessor access.
